title: Infant with High Fever and Lethargy

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: Hi, who are you calling for?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: My 8-month-old baby has a temperature of 103.5 degrees and is not responding to me, just lying there

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: This requires urgent medical evaluation. Please go to the emergency room immediately or call 911.

sbar_structure.situation: 8-month-old infant with fever (103.5°F) and decreased responsiveness, lethargy
sbar_structure.background: Infant, no significant medical history provided
sbar_structure.assessment: Pediatric fever with altered mental status; sepsis risk must be ruled out
sbar_structure.recommendation: Emergency room evaluation for fever workup and sepsis screening; possible blood cultures and IV fluids
